# DAILY ZONE BD

> DAILY ZONE BD is an e-commerce store in Bangladesh selling sneakers, sandals, apparel, and accessories.

## Site
- [Homepage](https://dailyzonebd.com/): New arrivals, featured categories, and best-selling products
- [Sneakers](https://dailyzonebd.com/products/sneakers): Sneaker catalog
- [Sandals](https://dailyzonebd.com/products/loafers-and-sandal): Sandals and loafers catalog
- [Contact](https://dailyzonebd.com/contact): Store contact information
